title: Stop Saying "Very Excited"! 3 Better English Words #shorts
description:
Stop saying "very excited". Use one of these words instead:
• Exhilarated: exhilarated after the ride
• Pumped (informal): pumped for the big game
• Thrilled: thrilled about the trip

Which one is new to you? Tell me in the comments.
